intro: Tourism, free-zone factories, mining and remittances power the Dominican economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Over ten million visitors arrive each year. Factories make medical devices, cigars and clothes. Gold, cocoa, bananas and sugar are exported.

chapters.title: Amber
text: Dominican amber often contains insects trapped millions of years ago.

keyTerms.meaning: An area with low taxes for export factories.

cardGroups.title: Made in the Dominican Republic
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things the Dominican Republic makes and sells to the world.
